notes.title: ASDAD Christmas Update is finally Here!
notes.content:
[img=http://giantenemylabs.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/Christmas_update_tease.png][/img]
We are pretty close to [b]Christmas[/b] and I've got a little surprise for all of you guys! You should all be able to update to [b]version 3.0[/b] of the game now, which adds a [b]New Guest Character[/b] and a number of improvements to the game! (It also has a small Christmas surprise!)

For instance now there's a [b]Single Player (Practice!) Race for the Idol[/b] mode, color-coded hint ribbons in item boxes, slightly improved progress saving, reworked voice acting, etc.

You can read the full official announcement on [url=http://giantenemylabs.com/asdad-christmas-update-is-live/]our website.[/url]

Hope you all have a [b]Merry Christmas[/b] and thanks again for your support!
